description: This file defines a singleton object 'SimpleRepoScope' that provides a helper method 'launchIo' for running background coroutines using Dispatchers.IO. It is designed to simplify launching background tasks in the context of an Android Kotlin project without relying on a Dependency Injection framework, with a note that WorkManager might be used in the future for guaranteed background work.

classes.name: SimpleRepoScope
classes.description: A singleton object providing a helper method 'launchIo' to run background coroutines on IO dispatcher.

methods.name: launchIo
methods.description: Creates and launches a coroutine on the IO dispatcher, executing the provided suspend lambda 'block'.
